verdict.rationale: cubic automatically reviews every new PR for logic, style, and security issues, offers deeper Ultrareview passes for risky changes, and supports auto-approval gated by review policy. It fits agent-driven workflows: a CLI reviews local changes and hands fix prompts to coding agents, an MCP server lets agents request reviews and triage findings, analytics track how much code is AI-authored, and flex capacity keeps reviews running past included line limits. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of review accuracy or throughput at high PR volume, and no documented handling specific to agent-authored PRs beyond analytics.
